correctness.rationale: Four exhaustive proof cases reconstruct the exact pointwise-stabilizer orbit invariant by round two: differing axis lengths via marked common-neighbour counts; square boards with nonattacking marks already after one round; square boards with an attacking marked pair via a first-round definable row and singleton crosspoints. The orbit-count formula follows from maximal-clique automorphisms and category sizes. Independent direct implementation checked 6413 configurations and 208470 aggregate vertex instances; explicit stabilizer permutations checked 1276 configurations. Finite checks corroborate rather than establish the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: A natural complete classification of the response of 1-dimensional counting refinement to arbitrary vertex individualizations in all two-factor complete Cartesian products: uniform sharp two-round depth, group-orbit recovery, explicit class counts/sizes, and a necessary square-vs-rectangle/nonattacking symmetry distinction. This supplies a family-wide orbit-refinability/Tinhofer certificate stronger in quantitative depth than a mere Tinhofer classification, and the proof identifies two different recovery mechanisms.
